oghamic.m: In, of, or pertaining to Ogham.

ogival.m: Having the curved, pointed shape of an ogive.

oglers.m: More than one ogler. ogler: one who ogles.

ogonek.m: A hook-shaped diacritical mark ⟨◌̨⟩ attached underneath a vowel, typically to indicate nasalisation, as in Ąą, Ęę, Įį, Ǫǫ or Ųų.

ogoneks.m: More than one ogonek. ogonek: a hook-shaped diacritical mark ⟨◌̨⟩ attached underneath a vowel, typically to indicate nasalisation, as in Ąą, Ęę, Įį, Ǫǫ or Ųų.

ogrish.m: Another spelling of ogreish. ogreish: resembling an ogre.
